correctness.rationale: For G with oriented incidence D, Q=D^T(DD^T)^+D and C=I-Q are Euclidean cut/cycle projectors. For arbitrary l1 or linfty projector, symmetrization over signed edge-aut permutations yields an invariant projection without norm increase. An invariant projector must equal Q or C when Hom_Gamma(B,Z)=0. Independently enumerated graph automorphism groups K4 24, Q3 48, dodeca GP(10,2) 120, reconstructed signed-edge characters, confirmed all three full joint multiplicity tables and inner products sum chi_B chi_Z=0. Independently solved rational Laplacian current for dodeca: every one of 20 Kirchhoff equations, s=38/15, r=19/30, hence 1+s-2r=34/15. Also computed tetra (3/2,3/2) and cube (2,11/6). Edge transitivity ensures maximum abs row sum; planar duality swaps cut/cycle to recover octa and icosa. This is an exhaustive finite five-graph proof and exact arithmetic, not extrapolation from a sample.
